ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.role: joiner for the agent-name list inside the built-in installation offer
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.tone: neutral inline Urdu enumeration; preserve agent names verbatim, no sentence punctuation
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.length: Two placeholders plus either spaces around اور or an Urdu comma followed by a space; variable-width names may wrap with the installation sentence.
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.note: pair joins exactly two names with اور and no comma; middle separates preceding names with the Urdu comma ،; other joins the final name with اور and no serial comma. This matches existing Urdu catalogue lists. Keep logical storage order and do not insert manual bidi controls; the renderer owns direction handling. Keep select labels pair, middle and other unchanged.

placeholders.position: pair for a two-name list, middle for non-final joins, end (the other arm) for the final join of three or more names
placeholders.head: first name or the already joined preceding names; preserve verbatim
placeholders.tail: next agent display name; preserve verbatim
